card: Adds a Python implementation of BIP352 silent payment scanning to the functional test framework along with helper functions for script identification. The implementation is tested against official BIP352 receiving test vectors in framework unit tests. This enables functional tests to independently verify silent payment outputs without relying on node logic. Extracted from PR 35302 (Silent Payments: Sending) to simplify review.
changed_since_previous: No substantial changes to the approach; the patch provides the concrete implementation of the BIP352 scanning module, script helper functions, and build setup for copying test vectors.
evidence: PR description: "Picked from #35302 as an isolated change that can be evaluated independently. This should make #35302 a bit easier to review. This adds a Python implementation of BIP352 scanning, without labels, so the functional tests can check silent payments outputs independently of `bitcoind` support."
problem: Functional tests cannot verify silent payment outputs independently of bitcoind, which complicates testing of forthcoming silent payments features like sending.

risk.why: Touches only functional test framework utilities and test data build configuration.

summary: Adds a Python implementation of BIP352 silent payment scanning (without labels) and script pattern-matching utilities to the functional test framework. It validates the scanning implementation against the BIP352 receiving test vectors directly within framework unit tests.
